status: fixed before any search, token arm or engine job of workstream repair; the code reads its thresholds from this file
base_scores: engine/results_dpann_v2/dpann__mmseqs__seq__e3c50s75__w3 (identical instance scores to the engine v1.5 replay in results_dpann_v5, checked 2026-11-12 07:15Z: 0 of 7,096 F1 or control values differ)

search.queries: unique sequences of (a) every gene in a base token with < 3 members and (b) the shorter gene (FASTA length; tie -> lower gid) of every same-contig, co-oriented gene pair at distance 1 with nucleotide gap <= 50 (overlaps included)
search.mmseqs: prefilter -s 7.5 --max-seqs 1000; align -e 1e-5 -a; no coverage filter at search time; self hits dropped
search.uniform: one parameter set for every query genome-wide; no gold-neighbourhood-specific search

variants.rescue1: query genes in tokens with 1 member
variants.rescue3: query genes in tokens with < 3 members

rescue.hit_rule: E <= 1e-5 and (alignment length on the shorter protein) / (shorter protein length) >= 0.8, shorter by FASTA length
rescue.target_token: the hit's base token (token of the plurality of the hit sequence's genes) has >= 2 members and differs from the query gene's base token
rescue.best_hit: highest bits, then lowest E, then larger target token, then lower target uid
rescue.resolution: simultaneous on base tokens; a gene whose best hit is itself a moved gene follows that gene's final token (pointer following); a cycle of moved genes takes the base token of its member with the largest base token (ties: lower token id). Only rescue3 can chain, because rescue1 targets never move.

split.pairs: same contig, same strand, position difference 1, nucleotide gap <= 50 (negative = overlap, included)
split.piece_hit: E <= 1e-5, piece covered >= 0.7 by its alignment to X, region on X >= 80 aa, region on X <= len(X) - 60 (subgenic predeclared composite definitions y_coverage_min, x_region_min_aa)
split.x_rule: one sequence X, present in a genome other than the pair's genome, aligned by both pieces; regions overlap by <= 20 aa (subgenic max_region_overlap_aa), the genomic N-terminal piece's region starts before the C-terminal piece's region on X, uncovered residues of X between the two regions <= 10, union of the two regions >= 0.8 of len(X)
split.x_choice: per pair, highest union coverage, then highest summed bits, then lower X uid
split.search_route: stage 1: shorter piece against all targets (search above); stage 2: longer piece aligned to the stage-1 X candidates (explicit pairs, align -e 1e-5 -a), at most 30 candidates per pair by stage-1 bits after the length and side prefilter
split.assignment: both genes receive X's token (token of the plurality of X's genes in the arm the split repair is applied to); a gene in two qualifying pairs takes the pair with higher union coverage, then summed bits
split.universe: unchanged: no genes merged or removed

arms.mmseqs__seq__e3c50s75_rescue1split__dpan: base + rescue1, then split with X token read from the rescue1 arm (split overrides rescue on genes in both)

engine: run_recurrence_dpann_arm.sbatch, W=3, null genome, OUTDIR=results_dpann_repair; base comparator results_dpann_v2

primary.split_genomes: test = even genome_code (odd = tune; used only to rank arms that pass)
primary.c1_summed_excess: DefenseFinder + TXSScan summed excess A - B on even genomes, 95% genome-bootstrap interval lower bound > -0.005 (compare_vs_base.txt, test line)
primary.c2_touched_f1: mean best-locus F1 (score_min2, gold instances with >= 2 resolved members) over instances on even genomes with >= 1 member gene whose token differs between arm and base: A - B >= +0.03 and paired genome-bootstrap 95% interval (2,000 draws, seed 17) excluding 0
primary.adopt: c1 and c2 both met; among adopted arms the one with the larger odd-genome summed excess difference is preferred

also_report: F1 / excess differences for all three callers
touched-instance F1, control F1 and excess differences, all callers, all / odd / even
instances touched through span genes (any gene between start_idx and end_idx) as a secondary set

amendment_1_rescue_error.status: written before the cut test, the variant arms or any engine run of this amendment; only data availability (partial flags) was inspected
amendment_1_rescue_error.partial_flags: canonical DPANN database proteins.partial: '00' 1,314,509 / '10' 92,550 / '01' 92,522 / '11' 2,467 / NULL 2,083,255 of the 3,585,303 universe genes. truncated(gene) = partial in {10, 01, 11} when present, else start <= 3 or end >= contig length_nt - 2 (contig end)

cut_test.complete: partial == '00' (the gene caller's flag); proteins under 34 aa skipped
cut_test.positives: families (base e3c50s75 tokens) of >= 3 members, strata family size {3-4, 5-9, 10-99, 100-999, >= 1000} x protein length {< 150, 150-299, 300-599, >= 600 aa}, 300 per stratum (6,000), seed 17
cut_test.negatives: base singletons, strata protein length as above, 500 per bin (2,000), seed 17
cut_test.cut: N- or C-terminal piece kept (50/50), kept fraction ~ U(0.15, 0.95), kept length = max(30, round(fraction x length)) (Sharur design)
cut_test.search: fragments against all unique sequences, same settings as the genome-wide search (-s 7.5 --max-seqs 1000; align -e 1e-5 -a)
cut_test.original_removed: the original gene is removed from the targets: a hit to its sequence is dropped when no other gene carries that sequence, otherwise kept with the token of the remaining genes; token sizes are counted without the original (a 3-member family stays eligible with 2)
cut_test.outcomes: positives: true family / wrong family / unplaced; negatives: false join / unplaced; overall, by fragment length {< 75, 75-149, 150-299, >= 300}, by kept fraction {0.15-0.35, 0.35-0.55, 0.55-0.75, 0.75-0.95}, by family-size stratum

variants_on_rescue3.base_rule: rescue3: genes in base tokens with < 3 members; hit E <= 1e-5, alignment covers >= 80% of the shorter protein, hit token (without the moving gene) >= 2 members and not the gene's own; best qualifying hit by bits; moves resolved together with pointer following
variants_on_rescue3.a: base rule + the moving gene (query) is the shorter protein: qlen <= tlen
variants_on_rescue3.b: a + the moving gene is truncated (partial flag, else contig end)
variants_on_rescue3.c: a + anchored: on every intact side of the moving gene the alignment starts (N side: qstart <= 11 and tstart <= 11) or ends (C side: qlen - qend <= 10 and tlen - tend <= 10) within 10 residues of both termini. Intact sides from the partial flag (else contig end) and strand: + strand left edge or - strand right edge truncated -> N missing, C intact; + strand right edge or - strand left edge truncated -> C missing, N intact; '11' -> no intact side, cannot pass; untruncated gene -> both sides intact
variants_on_rescue3.selection: the conditions filter the qualifying hits; the best hit is chosen among those that remain
variants_on_rescue3.cut_test_application: every cut fragment is a simulated edge truncation with a known intact side (the kept end), so it counts as truncated: cut-test rates of b equal a and of d equal c by construction; b and d differ from a and c only in genes moved genome-wide

amendment_1_rescue_error.engine: one arm per variant, W 3, deployed wrapper, OUTDIR=results_dpann_repair, arms mmseqs__seq__e3c50s75_rescue3{a,b,c,d}__dpann
amendment_1_rescue_error.gain_retained: computed on rescue3's even-genome touched-instance set (101 instances): variant mean F1 minus base >= 0.8 x rescue3's (+0.2598), i.e. >= +0.2078; own touched set reported beside
amendment_1_rescue_error.decision: default = the strictest variant (order d; then b or c, whichever moves fewer genes; then a; then rescue3) that (1) retains >= 80% of the gain, (2) has a summed DF+TXSS excess lower bound on even genomes > -0.005, (3) cut-test wrong-family rate < 3% of positives and (4) false-join rate < 8% of negatives. If no variant meets (3) and (4), say so; best trade-off = lowest wrong-family + false-join rate among variants meeting (1) and (2)
amendment_1_rescue_error.ribosomal: admissible only with >= 1,650 / 1,686 runs and >= 110 / 114 Parvarchaeaceae

refutation.glue: rescue raises touched-instance observed F1 and the random-placement control F1 by similar amounts (touched-instance excess difference interval includes 0 or is negative while F1 rises), or the largest token grows by more than 2x, or the 20 inspected rescued genes show low identity (< 0.3) full-length matches dominated by the target-shorter case
refutation.max_seqs: rescue destination tokens computed from the subgenic search S (max-seqs 8000) disagree with this search on > 5% of the rescued sample-genome genes, or split pairs found by the sizing study (broken-call-like, joint coverage >= 0.8, sample genomes) are recovered at < 85%
refutation.inspection: 20 rescued genes drawn uniformly at random (seed 17) from rescue1 with query length, target length, coverage of each, identity, E, target token size
